name: easyMO Discovery
description: Discover mobility, marketplace, and payments in Rwanda. Find rides, search businesses, generate MoMo QR codes, and connect with local services through AI-powered chat.
author: easyMO

use_cases.title: Find a Ride
use_cases.description: Ask 'Find me a moto driver nearby' and get matched with available drivers in your area.

use_cases.title: Search Businesses
use_cases.description: Ask 'Find restaurants near me' to discover local businesses and services.

use_cases.title: Generate Payment QR
use_cases.description: Ask 'Generate a MoMo QR for 5000 RWF' to create a payment QR code.

location.description: Location access is required for finding nearby drivers, passengers, and businesses.

authentication.description: User authentication is required for creating ride requests and managing listings.
